title: The wallet gate's vectors: the spend guard's answers computed by the Lean evaluator over the wallet's witness traces (bsv-stack-lean #184)
label: [M]
generated_by: tools/wallet_gate_export.py from lean/WalletGate/Export.lean (lake env lean --run); never edited by hand: change the Lean, re-export

row_shape.case: the Lean trace the row reads (a name of `Wallet.Check`, or `WalletGate.contendedSteps`), with its variant
row_shape.scenario: the draft of corpus/scenarios/ the trace is the Lean form of (its file name without .md), or null for a ruling's row with no draft
row_shape.step: how many steps of the trace were applied (1 is the state after one step)
row_shape.allow_received: the action's word at the door (createAction's allowReceived, R1 (d)); every query is exported with false and with true
row_shape.door: the input of this step: createAction, signAction, abortAction, internalizeAction, respend, track, competitor, strangerSpend or chain
row_shape.store_contended: whether the host's store was contended at this step's door (hostDoor's store word)
row_shape.store_wait_ms: the wait the host offered with a contended store, in milliseconds, or null
row_shape.params: the host's parameters by Lean name
row_shape.spend_depth: the host's spend depth as named in its config (Params.spendDepth)
row_shape.headers: the Lean name of the headers the guard was read against when they are not the step's own, else null
row_shape.headers_tip: the tip of the headers the guard was read against
row_shape.host_rules: the host's rules by Lean name
row_shape.host_rule_made: the name of the host's rule for its own made change, or null for no rule
row_shape.host_rule_made_allows: the words of the five a rule is ever consulted on (unknown, built, announced, seen, abandoned) that the made rule allows, or null
row_shape.host_rule_received: the name of the host's received arm, or null; ruleFor never reads it (R1 (d))
row_shape.coin_held: whether the wallet holds a record of the coin
row_shape.coin_frozen: the coin's frozen mark, or null
row_shape.coin_lock: free, locked, spent or lost, or null
row_shape.coin_lock_txid: the action that locks or spent the coin, or the competitor it is lost to, or null
row_shape.creator: the txid of the action that created the coin
row_shape.creator_held: whether the wallet holds that action
row_shape.creator_word: the creator's tracker word (one of the nine), or null
row_shape.creator_word_data: the word's data as a string: the height of mined, the reason of rejected, the competitors of conflicted joined by a space; else null
row_shape.creator_suspect: the creator's fork-in-progress mark, or null
row_shape.creator_under_received_rule: whether the creator was made under the R1 (d) word, or null
row_shape.creator_proof_height: the height of the creator's checked proof, or null
row_shape.creator_proof_root: the root of the creator's checked proof, or null
row_shape.header_root_at_proof_height: the merkle root the guard's headers hold at that height, or null (no proof, or no header: fail closed)
row_shape.dead_lineage: Wallet.deadLineage on the creator: some ancestor of ours is dead
row_shape.coin_word: Wallet.coinWord: absent, pending, confirmed, void, locked, spent, lost or frozen
row_shape.coin_word_data: the coin word's data as a string: the height of confirmed, the txid of locked, spent and lost; else null
row_shape.rule_for: Wallet.ruleFor's answer for the creator: the rule's name, or null for no rule (null too when no creator is held)
row_shape.rule_for_allows: the words of the five that rule allows, or null
row_shape.guard_depth: Wallet.guardDepth: the host's spend depth with 1 the floor (R3 (b))
row_shape.door_word: Wallet.doorWord of the creator's word (stale reads as seen), or null
row_shape.received_pending: Wallet.receivedPending's verdict on the creator's door word (true when the word claims nothing about the chain), or null
row_shape.door_spendable: Wallet.doorSpendable under guardParams and ruleFor, or null when no creator is held
row_shape.offerable_clause: the clause of offerableUnder that decided: offered, no coin, no creator action, held by a lock, frozen, creator suspect (fork in progress), dead lineage, or door: (the reason the creator's door is closed); offered exactly when offerable is true (a #guard over every row)
row_shape.host_answer: the host's answer at this step's door (Wallet.hostDoor): done, refused, or busy (the state handed back unchanged)
row_shape.host_answer_data: the refusal's reason, or the busy's wait in milliseconds as a string, else null
row_shape.label: [M]: computed by the Lean evaluator, never edited by hand
